metadata.short_desc: Send MiniMax voice messages from a QQ official bot or NapCat.
metadata.desc: Turn QQ text replies into voice messages with MiniMax synchronous speech. Supports the Open Platform WebSocket and Webhook adapters, and OneBot (aiocqhttp, including NapCat).

api_key.hint: MiniMax API key. Requests use Authorization: Bearer and the API host selected below.

api_base.hint: Save, then reopen this page. The voice list is loaded from the selected host, and the API key must be issued for that host.

model.hint: Speech model sent to T2A. HD costs more than Turbo on both hosts.

reply_mode.hint: Text and voice sends both. Voice only drops the text when the whole reply can be spoken. Smart speaks alone when the model, a voice message, or a keyword asks for it.

smart_agent.hint: Adds one instruction on QQ official chats and OneBot (aiocqhttp, including NapCat): start a reply with <voice-only/> when it is better heard than read. The marker is removed before the message is sent.

smart_mirror_voice.hint: When the user sends a voice message, reply with voice only.

smart_keywords.hint: If the user's message contains one of these, reply with voice only. Separate phrases with commas.

smart_fallback.hint: Used when the model, the user's voice, and the keywords all stay quiet. Text only skips the speech call.

language.hint: The voice list updates when this changes. Taken from the voice id prefix.

gender.hint: The voice list updates when this changes. Inferred from the voice name.

voice_id.hint: Changes with the language and gender above.

voices.title: MiniMax Voice studio
voices.description: Clone a voice, design one from a description, preview it, and keep it.
voices.heading: MiniMax Voice studio
voices.source_rule: mp3, m4a, or wav · 10 seconds to 5 minutes · up to 20 MB
voices.prompt_rule: Under 8 seconds, with the words spoken in it.
voices.verify_note: Cloning needs individual or enterprise verification on this MiniMax account.
voices.voice_id_optional_hint: Leave this blank and each take gets its own id.
voices.empty_shelf: Nothing here yet. A clone or a design will show up as a draft.
voices.audition_hint: A draft voice asks before it charges the one-time fee.
voices.no_key_body: Add an API key in this plugin's settings, then reload the page.
voices.clone_fee_later: Creating a draft does not charge the one-time voice fee.
voices.design_fee_later: The design fee is charged only when you keep the voice. This preview is billed by the character.
voices.voice_id_hint: 8–256 characters, starts with a letter, cannot end with - or _.
voices.voice_id_bad: 8–256 characters, starts with a letter, cannot end with - or _.
voices.han_rule: On the China host a Chinese character counts as 2 in these estimates.
voices.intl_rule: International estimates count every character as 1. MiniMax has not published the exact rule.
voices.draft_status: Not charged yet. Deleted by MiniMax in {days} days.
voices.deleted_status: Deleted. This voice id cannot be reused.
voices.err_type: Use an mp3, m4a, or wav file.
voices.err_size: The audio file is larger than 20 MB.
voices.err_duration_source: Source audio must be between 10 seconds and 5 minutes.
voices.err_duration_prompt: The example clip must be shorter than 8 seconds.
voices.err_prompt_pair: The example clip and its transcript must be sent together.
voices.confirm_keep_body: MiniMax charges {cost} to save this voice.
voices.kept_done: Saved. The one-time fee has been charged.
voices.confirm_remove_body: This only removes it from the page.
voices.confirm_delete_body: MiniMax will not let you use this voice id again.
voices.confirm_try_body: Playing it charges the {fee} one-time fee, plus the sentence.
voices.use_done: QQ replies will use this voice.
voices.no_bridge: Open this page from the plugin detail screen.
voices.example_1: A calm young woman, low and warm, speaking slowly like a late-night radio host.
voices.example_2: A bright middle-aged man speaking briskly, like a news anchor.
voices.example_3: A soft narrator, unhurried, with a little smile in the voice.
voices.tip_flow: The steps for cloning a recording and designing a voice.
voices.clone_step_1: Upload a recording of the voice to copy.
voices.clone_step_2: Optionally add a short clip of that voice, and type the words spoken in it.
voices.clone_step_3: Write a preview sentence and create a draft. Playing it from the list does not charge the one-time fee.
voices.clone_step_4: Keep the draft to save it, then use it for QQ replies. An unused draft is removed after 7 days.
voices.design_step_1: Describe the voice. The phrases and examples can fill this in.
voices.design_step_2: Write a preview sentence, create a draft, and listen to it in the list.
voices.design_step_3: Keep the one you want. The design fee is charged when you keep it.
voices.design_step_4: Use the saved voice for QQ replies. Another take starts a new voice id.
voices.tip_source: The recording MiniMax copies. mp3, m4a, or wav, from 10 seconds to 5 minutes, up to 20 MB.
voices.tip_prompt: Optional clip of the same person, under 8 seconds. It teaches pronunciation, and it must be sent with the transcript.
voices.tip_transcript: The words spoken in the example clip. Fill this in only when a clip is attached.
voices.tip_voice_id: The name stored for this voice. 8–256 characters, starts with a letter, and cannot end with - or _. A deleted id cannot be reused.
voices.tip_preview: The first line this draft speaks. Billed by the character. Creating the draft does not charge the one-time fee.
voices.tip_advanced: Optional checks on the source recording. Leave these alone unless the audio needs them.
voices.tip_boost: A language for MiniMax to favor, such as Chinese or English. Leave this blank to let MiniMax decide.
voices.tip_expected: What you think the source recording says, up to 200 characters. MiniMax compares the audio with this text.
voices.tip_accuracy: How closely the recording must match the expected transcript, from 0 to 1. Empty uses MiniMax's default, 0.7.
voices.tip_noise: Remove background noise from the source before cloning. Leave this off unless the recording is noisy.
voices.tip_volume: Even out the loudness of the source before cloning.
voices.tip_clone_submit: Create a draft and generate the preview. The one-time clone fee is charged only when you keep the voice.
voices.tip_design_prompt: Who is speaking, and how: age, pitch, pace, and mood. Up to 2000 characters.
voices.tip_chips: Add this phrase to the description.
voices.tip_examples: Replace the description with this example.
voices.tip_design_preview: The first line this draft speaks, up to 500 characters. Billed by the character. The design fee waits until you keep the voice.
voices.tip_design_id: Leave this blank and each take gets a new id. A deleted id cannot be reused.
voices.tip_design_submit: Create a draft from the description and the preview sentence.
voices.tip_another: Create another draft with a new voice id, using the same description.
voices.tip_audition_voice: The voice that speaks the sentence. A draft asks you to confirm the one-time fee before it plays.
voices.tip_audition_model: The speech model for this sentence. HD costs more per character than Turbo.
voices.tip_audition_text: Your own sentence, up to 1000 characters. The estimate on the button is the character cost.
voices.tip_audition_play: Speak the sentence with the selected voice and model.
voices.tip_play: Play the preview stored for this voice. This does not charge the one-time fee.
voices.tip_keep: Save this draft on the account. This charges the one-time fee plus one short sentence.
voices.tip_try: Type your own sentence for this voice in the bar below.
voices.tip_use: Make QQ replies use this voice. A draft has to be kept first.
voices.tip_delete: Delete this voice at MiniMax. The id cannot be used again.
voices.tip_remove: Drop this row from the list. MiniMax is not called again.
voices.tip_drop_draft: Take this unsaved preview off the page. MiniMax drops it on its own after 7 days, and the id stays reserved until then.
voices.confirm_drop_body: MiniMax cannot delete an unsaved preview. It expires on its own, and the voice id stays reserved until then. This only removes it from the page.
voices.preview_removed: Removed from this page. MiniMax drops an unsaved preview on its own.
